item.title: Gold surges amid fed rate cut hopes; City-wise prices here | Dynamite News
item.description: Gold prices surged on November 29 amid expectations of a US Fed rate cut next month. 24K gold is trading above ₹1.27 lakh per 10 grams in Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, and other major cities, while 22K gold is over ₹1.16 lakh. Silver prices also saw a slight rise.

item.title: Karnataka CM Row: DK Shivakumar meets Siddaramaiah for breakfast; Congress high command intervenes | Dynamite News
item.description: Amid the ongoing tussle over the Karnataka Chief Minister post, Deputy CM DK Shivakumar visited CM Siddaramaiah’s residence on Saturday morning for breakfast. The meeting comes after Congress high command instructed both leaders to resolve the issue internally before the upcoming assembly session.

item.title: WPL 2026 Full Schedule Released: Final not on holiday; Mumbai and Vadodara to host matches | Dynamite News
item.description: The full schedule for the WPL 2026 has been released. This time, the final of the tournament will not be played on a holiday. A total of 22 matches will be played over 28 days, including two doubleheaders.

item.description: Actor Randeep Hooda celebrated his second wedding anniversary with wife Lin Laishram and surprised fans by announcing that they are soon going to become parents. Sharing a romantic picture on Instagram, Hooda revealed the exciting news.

item.title: Confused about SIR form? Here’s how to confirm submission | Dynamite News
item.description: The Election Commission of India has introduced an online facility to help voters check whether their SIR (Special Intensive Revision) enumeration form has been successfully submitted or not.

item.title: Akhilesh Yadav accuses ECI of deadly pressure in SIR drive; Here’s what he said | Dynamite News
item.description: amajwadi Party Chief Akhilesh Yadav targeted the Election Commission over the ongoing Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process, alleging that BLOs are being pressurised and forced to work under extreme stress. He questioned the urgency behind the SIR exercise and cited incidents of alleged pressure leading to tragic outcomes.

item.title: Mahindra opens bookings for BE 6 Formula E Edition; Only 999 units to be sold | Dynamite News
item.description: Mahindra has introduced the exclusive BE 6 Formula E Edition, limiting its production to just 999 units. The company has announced the prices for the FE2 and FE3 variants and confirmed that official bookings will begin on 14 January 2026, with deliveries scheduled from 14 February 2026.

item.title: CJI Surya Kant highlights stress in Judges’ work; Advises fun activities to stay healthy | Dynamite News
item.description: Chief Justice of India, Justice Surya Kant, emphasized the importance of recreational activities for judges to maintain good physical and mental health. Speaking at the inaugural ceremony of the All India Judges Badminton Championship in Delhi, he said judges work long hours under intense pressure and must adopt activities like sports, yoga, meditation, or walking to stay refreshed.

item.title: Delhi Blast: NIA extends custody of 4 accused for 10 more days; Click for details | Dynamite News
item.description: In the Delhi Red Fort terror attack case, the NIA special court has extended the custody of four accused, including Dr Shaheen and Dr Mujammil, by 10 days. During this period, the NIA conducted detailed questioning and site inspections, including Shaheen’s room at Al-Falah University and her residence in Khori Jamalpur, to investigate possible links with other suspects.
